A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we proposed a new data provision problem model for real-time data acquisition from Sensor Web, and we compared four data provision algorithms with the commonly used static policy, and we also developed a new performance evaluation method for the data provision algorithms.
the Static Policy, the KF and the H-MIAD are more suitable for sensors with stable time intervals, while the H-AIMD performs better for data with much fluctuations in the time intervals.

the data provision problem can be modeled as a dynamic system with a time series input and a series of data requests.
